title: Develo Magazine Appendix CD-ROM for SegaSaturn
native_title: デベロ・マガジン Ａｐｐｅｎｄｉｘ ＣＤ－ＲＯＭ ｆｏｒ ＳＥＧＡＳＡＴＵＲＮ
overview: Develo Magazine Appendix CD-ROM for SegaSaturn is a Japanese cover disc that came packaged with an issue of Develo Magazine. It holds non-interactive demos of Sega Saturn games that were still to be released, giving a look at upcoming titles.
